title: 第1章 剑道圣体第2章 震天动地
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
【小无敌爽文；有女人，但只是抬高主角的NPC，请各位观众老爷放心看。
九玄大陆，凌霄剑宗
一间朴素的竹屋小院之内，一身穿黑袍的俊逸青年，面前摆着一口铜锅，里面涮着肉片。
他夹了一口肉，喝了一口酒，嘴里哼着小曲，很是惬意。
他叫秦峰，五年前因加班猝死，穿越到这个实力为尊的修行世界。
穿越后他觉醒了天下最顶尖十二圣体之一的剑道圣体。
别人花费百年才能领悟的剑道境界，他只需呼吸之间。
而他却只想享受生活，做宗门任务？没时间！
找个漂亮道侣？太麻烦了！
参加宗门活动？没兴趣！
没事吃个火锅，喝点小酒，那多快乐，他的人生目标就是逍遥一千年。
不过要拥有一千年的寿元，至少要达到元婴期。
思索间，一名青年女子推门而入，她一身绿色衣裙，长相娇俏可爱。
一双灵动的大眼睛仿佛会说话一般，只不过脸色呈现病态的苍白。
她手中拿一壶灵酒，献宝似的道：“二师兄，我给你带了你最喜欢喝的梨花醉。”
此人是他的小师妹柳梦瑶，二人从小一起长大，他们这一脉人丁凋零，除了二人就剩一个战斗狂的大师姐。
秦峰一见是梨花酿，赶忙接了过来，打开瓶塞一闻，一脸陶醉之色。
“好酒啊，多谢小师妹。”
柳梦瑶嘻嘻一笑道：“师兄喜欢便好，今天可是宗门大比的日子，师父师姐她们都过去了，你不去吗？”
秦峰摆了摆手，晕乎乎道：“没兴趣！”

柳梦瑶道：“那我也不去了，反正咱们杀剑峰大师姐最能打，咱们去了也没用。”
她也坐了下来，她不知道师兄在哪学来的烹饪方式，二师兄说这叫火锅，不过味道是极好的。
喝了半个时辰，柳梦瑶小脸红扑扑道：“二师兄，你记不记得你小时候说长大要娶我来着？”
秦峰面色一僵，是有这么回事，但他可不想找道侣。
小师妹人很美，对自己也好，是无数天骄心中的梦中情人，追求她的人，硬是把郁郁葱葱的杀剑锋踏出一条路来。
但自己的目标可是逍遥千年，于是道：“那都是三岁小孩的戏言，当不得真。”
柳梦瑶气鼓鼓道：“师兄，你怎么能这样，说话不算话，那可是你亲口说的。”
“而且你当时已经四岁了，不是三岁小孩！”
“你真的忍心拒绝你超级无敌可爱的小师妹吗？”
秦峰一脸黑线，柳梦瑶已经不是一次提起这事了，让他有些头大。
看来只能用老办法了，他捂着头说道：“哎哟我去，这梨花醉酒劲儿真大，头有点晕。”
柳梦瑶鼓着腮帮子道：“不要转移话题！”
那模样甚是可爱。
她话音未落，秦峰哐啷一声趴在桌子上，人事不醒。
柳梦瑶嘴撅的老高，气鼓鼓的说道：“臭师兄，我看你能装到几时！”
然而下一刻，她突然感觉到一阵眩晕，赶忙喊道：“师兄……”
然后便倒在了桌上。
content_en:
[Little Wudi is a cool article; there are women, but they are just NPCs who promote the protagonist. Please feel free to read it.
Jiuxuan Continent, Lingxiao Sword Sect
In a small courtyard of a simple bamboo house, a handsome young man in black robes had a copper pot in front of him with slices of meat in it.
He took a bite of meat, took a sip of wine, and hummed a tune, feeling very comfortable.
His name is Qin Feng. He died suddenly due to overtime work five years ago and traveled to this world of cultivation where strength is respected.
After traveling through time, he awakened the Sword Dao Holy Body, one of the top twelve holy bodies in the world.
The realm of swordsmanship that took others hundreds of years to comprehend was only a breath away for him.
But he just wants to enjoy life and do sect tasks? No time!
Looking for a beautiful Taoist companion? What a hassle!
Participate in sect activities? Not interested!
It would be so happy to have a hot pot and drink some wine. His goal in life is to live happily for a thousand years.
However, to have a lifespan of one thousand years, one must at least reach the Nascent Soul stage.
While thinking about it, a young woman pushed open the door and walked in. She was wearing a green dress and looked pretty and cute.
A pair of big, smart eyes seemed to be able to speak, but his face was sickly pale.
She held a pot of spiritual wine in her hand and said as if offering a treasure: "Second Senior Brother, I brought you your favorite pear blossom wine."
This person is his younger junior sister Liu Mengyao. The two grew up together. The number of people in their lineage has withered away. Apart from the two, there is only one senior sister who is crazy about fighting.
When Qin Feng saw that it was pear blossom wine, he quickly took it, opened the cork and smelled it, with a look of intoxication on his face.
"Great wine, thank you so much, junior sister."
Liu Mengyao smiled and said: "Senior brother, it's fine if you like it. Today is the day of the sect competition. Master, senior sister and others have already passed, won't you go?"
Qin Feng waved his hand and said dazedly: "Not interested!"
Liu Mengyao said: "Then I won't go either. Anyway, we kill Jianfeng Senior Sister the best, so it's useless for us to go."
She also sat down. She didn't know where her senior brother learned how to cook. The second senior brother said it was called hot pot, but the taste was excellent.
After drinking for half an hour, Liu Mengyao blushed and said, "Second Senior Brother, do you remember when you were a child, you said you wanted to marry me when you grow up?"
Qin Feng's face froze, something like this was happening, but he didn't want to find a Taoist companion.
The junior sister is very beautiful, and she is also kind to herself. She is the dream lover in the hearts of countless geniuses. Those who pursue her forcefully step out of the lush killing sword.
But his goal is to live happily for a thousand years, so he said: "Those are just the jokes of a three-year-old child, they cannot be taken seriously."
Liu Mengyao said angrily: "Senior brother, how could you do this? You don't mean what you say. You said it yourself."
"And you were already four years old, not a three-year-old!"
"Do you really have the heart to reject your super invincible and cute little junior sister?"
Qin Feng had a dark look on his face. Liu Mengyao had mentioned this matter not once, which made him feel a little dizzy.
It seemed that the only option was to use the old method. He covered his head and said, "Oh, let me go. This Lihua is so drunk that her head is a little dizzy."
Liu Mengyao puffed up her cheeks and said, "Don't change the subject!"
That look is very cute.
Before she finished speaking, Qin Feng lay on the table with a bang, unconscious.
Liu Mengyao pouted Lao Gao and said angrily: "Smelly senior brother, let's see how long you can keep pretending!"
However, the next moment, she suddenly felt dizzy and hurriedly shouted: "Senior brother..."
Then he fell on the table.
